messages:
Maria (SE): Quick async check-in for the Argus Systems trial — kickoff next Wed. Trying to map owners for infra/deps + acceptance criteria so we don't scramble.
Liam (Sales): Confirming success criteria from the customer: latency p99 <= 200ms, end-to-end throughput ~10 qps, and no customer data persisted. Also they'd like a canary before GA. :thumbsup:
Priya (Eng PM): Thanks. I'll own the internal rollout plan & milestones. Proposed milestones: 1) VPC peering + firewall rules (Ethan) by Tue, 2) SSO config + token flow (Ethan + Zoe) by Wed morning, 3) model variant freeze & canary deploy (Eng) by Wed noon, 4) end-to-end smoke + perf check (SRE) Wed afternoon.
Ethan (Infra): I can do VPC peering. Need the customer's ASN + subnet ranges and the peering CIDR. I'll create the peering request today and tag TRIAL-321. ETA EOD tomorrow unless they need manual approval from their netops.
Jules (Customer Success): I'll collect the ASN/subnets and share with Ethan. Also will schedule a 30m pre-kickoff with Argus to validate network windows. Do you want that before I hand off to infra or after I send details? 
Maria (SE): Please send details now so Ethan can start the request. For SSO: Argus uses SAML with IdP metadata. Zoe, can you confirm if we need a local proxy for the SAML assertions or if the hosted plane can handle it? 
Zoe (SRE): Hosted control plane can handle SAML, but we need to toggle the SP metadata flag and ensure our session TTL aligns with Argus' assertion lifetime (they use 12h). Also alerting: set an SLO on token refresh errors. I'll add a runbook snippet.
Priya (Eng PM): For the canary, plan is 10% traffic for 2 hours then 50% for 1h if no regressions. Maria, can you provide representative prompts + eval set? Need it for quality gating.
Maria (SE): Uploaded prompt set to https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TRIAL-321 (see attachments). Sample quality gating metric: response pass-rate >= 95% on intent classification, and no hallucination flag. I'll add exact prompts.
Ethan (Infra): Created peering request TRIAL-321-PEER and assigned to netops. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/TRIAL-321?focusedCommentId=1001
deploy-bot: VPC peering request TRIAL-321-PEER created by Ethan. Status: pending-approval.
Zoe (SRE): On perf: I'll run a baseline against our hosted model-var-v2. Metrics I'll collect: p50/p95/p99 latency, cpu/gpu utilization, kv cache hit rate. Will post results in this thread.
Liam (Sales): Customer asks about data retention — can we confirm logs are ephemeral and only the tokens needed for billing are stored? Security reviewed this last quarter, right? 
Priya (Eng PM): Security: logs are ephemeral by default for trials; billing tokens persisted in the billing DB only. I'll loop in Security if Argus requires additional controls.
Maria (SE): Action items recap:
- Ethan: get VPC peering request approved and share ETA (owner)
- Zoe: perf smoke + runbook, SAML config notes (owner)
- Priya: rollout milestones + canary plan (owner)
- Maria: prompt/eval set + success thresholds (owner)
- Jules: schedule pre-kickoff & collect ASN/subnets (owner)
Please reply with any blockers. If no objections I'll mark milestones in TRIAL-321 by EOD.
Liam (Sales): No blockers from my side. If infra timeline slips we may push trial start by 24h. I'll notify Argus if that happens.
Ethan (Infra): One potential blocker: Argus' netops requires a signed AUP before peering. Jules, can you escalate? That's the only manual step that could add 48h.
Jules (Customer Success): On it, escalating now. ETA for signed AUP: tomorrow morning.
Zoe (SRE): I'll kick off a small bench run tonight to get a headstart; will post numbers here. :rocket:
Priya (Eng PM): Great — if everyone can ack their owners by EOD we'll be set. I'll update TRIAL-321 with the milestones and owners.
Maria (SE): Acked owners. Thanks all — will follow up with the prompt notes and the customer's sample payloads.
deploy-bot: Ticket TRIAL-321 updated: milestones added, assignees set.
Zoe (SRE): Quick note for the canary config (copying here):
```
canary:
  - percent: 10
    duration: 120m
  - percent: 50
    duration: 60m
rollout_checks:
  - latency.p99 <= 200ms
  - error_rate < 0.5%
  - quality.pass_rate >= 95%
```
Priya (Eng PM): Perfect. If any owner needs help ping me or drop comments on TRIAL-321. Closing async for now — will do a short sync tomorrow if needed.
Maria (SE): Thanks everyone. :clap:
